duration.words_json_alignment: Scribe word starts vs. audio onsets: median offset +0.015 s (energy rise -0.01 s); within half a frame, so no correction is needed.

video.rounding_policy: ceil: 66.107211 s x 30 = 1983.216 frames -> 1984 frames. Pad the decoded audio with 1152 samples (26.1 ms) of digital silence so that audio = 1984 x 1470 = 2,916,480 samples = 66.133333 s = video duration exactly. (The alternative, 1983 frames, would cut 318 samples (7.2 ms) of the micro-fade.)
video.master_audio_wav: audio_master_1984f_f32.wav (float32) / audio_master_1984f_s16.wav (PCM16), 44.1 kHz stereo, exactly 2,916,480 samples
video.frame_convention: frame = floor(time*30): the frame whose display interval [f/30,(f+1)/30) contains the event. To make a visual hit read as "on" the sound, put the change on this frame (or 1 frame earlier for hard cuts).
video.mux_advice: Mux from the padded WAV (e.g. -c:a aac -b:a 256k or libopus); never stream-copy the MP3 (its 66.142 s container duration and priming would desync the end).

loudness.normalisation_hint: Integrated loudness is -19.7 LUFS with 6.9 dB of true-peak headroom. +3.7 dB gives -16 LUFS (TP about -3.2 dBTP); +5.7 dB gives -14 LUFS (TP about -1.2 dBTP). Apply the gain only if the delivery spec asks for it.
loudness.stereo: Narration is mixed dead-centre (it does not raise the side channel); the music is very wide (side approximately equal to mid in every band). Side = (L-R)/2 is a near voice-free view of the music.

per_frame.npy: audio_frames.npy (float32, shape [1984, 21], rows = video frames, columns as listed)

phrases.text: There was a time when the world knew only one realm,
and swore it would never end.
and every lord who had sat at that table looked at the empty chair
and saw his own head beneath the crown.
The wars lasted a hundred years and ended nothing.
Roads were swallowed by the forest.
Men forgot what lay beyond their own borders,
and the world grew dark at its edges.
Now every ruler believes the world can be made whole again.
what will the chronicles say of you?

story_beats.desc: Golden age litany: one realm, one table, one oath, one crown
The oath: they raised their cups and swore it would never end
The king dies without heir; every lord eyes the empty chair and the crown
A hundred years of war: cities fall, roads swallowed, borders forgotten, the world grows dark
Now: every ruler believes the world can be made whole; one banner, one village, one blank page
The question: when this age is remembered, what will the chronicles say of you?

key.estimate: D minor (natural/Aeolian; Bb and F major-7 colours, C#/D drone beating)

music.instrumentation_note: No neural stem separation was possible (model hosts are blocked). Timbre conclusions come from the side channel, pitch-stability (vibrato) measurements, HPSS and band balance, so they are heuristics.
music.percussion: None detected. HPSS percussive ratio in music-only gaps is 0.01-0.16 (narration frames 0.25). Every strong <200 Hz transient in the mix falls inside narration words (narrator F0 is 73-134 Hz).

tempo.verdict: Unmetered, rubato ambient score with no steady beat. Autocorrelation peaks at 0.35/0.46/0.71 s follow the narration rhythm (2.85 words/s). The only robust periodicity is the slow bass bar pulse in 42.8-57.6 s.

bar_pulse.section: 42.78-57.55 s (bass returns until the final recession)

sections.label: Drone / golden age
sections.music: Fast fade-in (~0.5 s) of a dark D pedal drone (open fifth D-A, lowest partial ~71 Hz with ~30-cent, 6-8 Hz wobble) under a soft, very wide sustained pad. No percussion. The drone re-swells in narration gaps; music-only level -38 dBFS (3.5 s) rising to -31 dBFS (13.4 s).

sections.label: Lament (drone exits)
sections.music: The D drone fades from ~16.8 s (-15 dB at ~17.8 s, -25 dB by ~18.3 s, i.e. under "and left no heir"). Mid-register sustained chords take over (D minor 7 -> F major 7 colour, energy 250 Hz-2 kHz, no sub-bass) with ensemble-like pitch wobble (10-12 cents at 6-7 Hz): string-section / choir-pad timbre. Music-only level ~-31 dBFS; fullest around 23-25.5 s.

sections.label: Hollow war (music almost silent)
sections.music: Right after "...beneath the crown." the music collapses by ~20 dB (from ~-27 dBFS at 25 s to -47 dBFS at 27 s) and stays at or below about -45 dBFS for ~7 s: under the whole of "The wars lasted a hundred years and ended nothing." and the start of "Cities fell to ruin." Only a thin, airy, high, bass-less texture remains (no sub-bass, no percussion). Two fully exposed near-silent gaps: 26.6-28.1 s and 31.8-32.7 s (-47 dBFS).

sections.label: Ruin plateau (soft pad returns)
sections.music: A soft, mid-register Dm(add9) pad returns at ~33.9-34.0 s (+5 dB) and holds a plateau around -40 dBFS under "Roads were swallowed by the forest" and "Men forgot what lay beyond their own borders", creeping up to ~-36 dBFS by 41.5 s; a D7 colour (F# appears) in the 41 s gap. Still no bass below ~60 Hz.

sections.label: Rise to climax (bass returns, slow bar pulse)
sections.music: Big low-register entry at 42.78 s on "the world grew dark" (+26 dB in 22-120 Hz), then bass swells every ~2.1 s (42.78, 44.85, 47.00, 49.06, 51.21, 53.30, 55.49, 57.55 s): a slow bar pulse (~114 bpm if 4 beats per bar). Fullest, widest, brightest texture of the piece: a sustained Bb3 (233 Hz, strong 2nd-6th partials, ~10-cent vibrato: horn / cello / choir-like) over F and Bb major-7 harmony; music-only level -32.5 dBFS (44.5 s) -> -30 (50 s) -> -25.6 dBFS in the climax gap 58.14-59.46 s (loudest music of the piece, Bbmaj7 colour).

sections.label: Recession under the question
sections.music: From ~59.4 s, exactly as "what will the chronicles say of you?" begins, the music pulls back ~19 dB in ~1.4 s (-25 dBFS -> -44 dBFS by ~60.8 s); the bass is gone by ~60.8 s. The final words sit almost alone over a faint high chord.

sections.label: Tail (ring-out, no narration)
sections.music: After the last word (61.84 s) only a soft, very stable (pitch sd 4 cents), bass-less and dark (nothing above ~2 kHz) high chord remains (G5-E5-A5-C6 partials: an open, unresolved Am7/C6 colour, not the D-minor tonic), decaying ~1 dB/s from -39 to -44 LUFS. The file ends at 66.107 s while still at ~-48 dBFS, with only a ~30 ms micro-fade: an abrupt end unless the picture covers it.

drone.pitch: D (open fifth D2-A2-D3-A3; lowest partial ~71 Hz = flat D2)

sync_points_top25.what: Picture start. Audio frames 0-3 are silent; sound begins at frame 4. Fade up from black over frames 0-4 at most.
Narration "There was a time..." and the D drone start together (strongest attack of the file at 0.17 s, frame 5).
Litany 1/4 "one realm" ("realm" at 3.04 s, frame 91).
Litany 2/4 "one table" ("table" at 4.68 s, frame 140), with a drone re-swell at 4.22 s.
Litany 3/4 "one oath"; then a 0.47 s near-silence (6.17-6.63 s, -45 dBFS) and a +10 dB swell.
Litany 4/4 "one crown." (attack on "crown" at 7.65 s, frame 229). End of the golden-age beat at 8.28 s.
B2 oath: "They raised their cups" ("cups" attack 10.26 s, frame 307). Music crescendo 6.2 -> 9.0 s peaks here.
"and swore it would never end." Strongest early drone swell at 11.94 s (frame 358); phrase ends 13.42 s, then a 1.46 s music-only gap (frames 402-446) for the panel change.
B3 death: "Then the king died" ("died" at 15.64 s, frame 469).
The D drone (the floor of the score) fades out under "and left no heir": -15 dB at 17.82 s (frame 534), gone by 18.28 s.
"and every lord..." Lament chords (Dm9/F colour), music about 5 dB louder than in B1 (about -28 dBFS). "empty chair" at 21.88-22.72 s (frames 656-681).
"and saw his own head beneath the crown." ("crown" at 26.18 s, frame 785).
The music collapses by about 20 dB into near-silence (frames 797-844, -47 dBFS for 1.6 s). This is the strongest internal boundary. Hold, stillness or a cut to black.
B4 war: "The wars lasted a hundred years and ended nothing." The music stays at or below about -45 dBFS (nearly silent) until about 33.9 s, with a second silent gap at 31.73-32.67 s.
"Cities fell to ruin." (attack 32.92 s, frame 987; "fell" 33.32 s, frame 999)
A soft pad returns (about +7 dB, 33.4 -> 35.4 s) into "Roads were swallowed by the forest." (35.04 s, frame 1051).
"Men forgot what lay beyond their own borders," (attack 37.98 s, frame 1139). The music sits on a -40 dBFS plateau.
Biggest musical event: the bass and low register enter on "grew" ("the world grew dark", phrase starts 41.80 s), +26 dB in 22-120 Hz. "dark" lands at 43.08 s (frame 1292).
A bass swell in the 1.54 s music-only gap (frames 1336-1382). Bar pulse #2 of 8 (period about 2.115 s).
B5 present: "Now every ruler believes the world can be made whole again." Bass pulses at 47.00 s (frame 1410) and 49.06 s (frame 1471).

Litany 2: "One banner," / "one village," (51.98 s, frame 1559) / "one blank page." (53.30 s, frame 1599). Bass pulses land on "banner" (51.21 s) and "one [blank page]" (53.30 s). Bb major in the gap just before (49.72-50.80 s).
B6: "When this age is remembered," Bass pulse #8 at 57.55 s (frame 1726) on "remembered".
Music climax: the loudest music of the piece (-25.6 dBFS) in a 1.32 s music-only gap, peaking at 58.67 s (frame 1760). Best spot for the big visual reveal.

"what will the chronicles say of you?" The music recedes about 19 dB from 59.43 s to 60.80 s and the bass is gone by 60.79 s. "chronicles" at 60.06 s (frame 1801), "you?" at 61.56-61.84 s (frames 1846-1855).

Narration ends. A 4.27 s ring-out of a soft high unresolved chord follows (-44 -> -48 dBFS, about -1 dB/s): title or logo hold. Micro-fade at 66.075 s (frame 1982); last sample 66.107 s; final video frame is 1983 (1984 frames in total).
